title: Timeline, sequencer and MCP tests declare the programs and data they read, and run this build's CLI

needles: ## A timeline test that loads a plugin or forks declares it in its manifest
TEST_CASE("pulp audio shell-outs say so when no CLI is there to run"

installed_sdk.rationale: Test registration and test code only: no header, target, or installed artifact changes.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, handler, or document shape changes; the MCP audio tests now run this build's CLI instead of whatever sits in the checkout's build directory.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition, schema entry, or handler changes; only the tests that drive the existing audio tools change.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged; declaring a test's runtime spawn edges is CI test topology, not a design-time capability.
